newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares quiet at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares quiet at mid-session.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse remained unchanged at mid-session on Thursday in restricted trade as both buyers and sellers stayed on the sidelines, brokers said.
At 12.45 p.m. (0645 GMT), the Delhi sensitive index was slightly up by 0.62 points at 745.07.

"The narrow movement in stocks indicates that both buyers and sellers are keeping their fingers crossed and awaiting the financial budget before resuming their buying activity," said Vijay Agarwal of brokers Mass Financial Services.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram is scheduled to present the annual budget on February 28.
Reliance Industries quoted 0.55 rupees higher at 273.10.
